import numpy as np
a=np.array(g)
h,w=a.shape
outside=np.zeros_like(a,bool)
stack=[(r,0) for r in range(h)]+[(r,w-1) for r in range(h)]+[(0,c) for c in range(w)]+[(h-1,c) for c in range(w)]
while stack:
    y,x=stack.pop()
    if y<0 or y>=h or x<0 or x>=w or outside[y,x] or a[y,x]!=0: continue
    outside[y,x]=True
    stack+=[(y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)]
out=a.copy()
for r in range(h):
    for c in range(w):
        if a[r,c]==0 and not outside[r,c]: out[r,c]=8  # placeholder
# compute per enclosed region
seen=np.zeros_like(a,bool)
res=a.copy()
for r in range(h):
    for c in range(w):
        if a[r,c]==0 and not outside[r,c] and not seen[r,c]:
            stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
            seen[r,c]=True
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and a[yy,xx]==0 and not outside[yy,xx] and not seen[yy,xx]:
                        seen[yy,xx]=True; stack.append((yy,xx))
            fill=(len(comp))%10
            for y,x in comp: res[y,x]=fill
            print('region size',len(comp),'fill',fill)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in res))
